name: vscode-taskexplorer
description: Tasks and Scripts GUI | Visual UI for easy execution and management of tasks and scripts
appstrings.getLicense: Open the Task Explorer checkout page in an external browser
taskexplorer.parseError: Task Explorer task detection: failed to parse the file {0}
config.taskexplorer.store.compress: Compress persisted datafile (turning storage compression off is recommended for debugging purposes only)
config.taskexplorer.store.secure: Secure persisted datafile with 128-bit or 256-bit encryption
config.taskexplorer.store.secureStrength: Cryptographic strength used when encrypting data perisisted to DataStore (has no effect if `#store.secure#` is *off*)
config.taskexplorer.enableExplorerView: Enable **Task Explorer** in the `Files Explorer` view
config.taskexplorer.http.proxySupport: Type of proxy used for http requests, or `off` to disable proxy support
config.taskexplorer.http.strictSSL: Enforce SSL secure connection on http requests.  Can be used to diagnose or bypass any connection issues
config.taskexplorer.taskProviders: Enabled task and script types to display in the task tree.  New types can be added for tasks provided externally by other extensions
config.taskexplorer.environment: Configure Task Explorer specific environment variable names and values.  Used in specific cases only, e.g. the `Jenkins` task provider
config.taskexplorer.exclude: Configure glob patterns for files and folders that should be excluded from taskfile detection **Note:** the vsc filesystem watchers that process taskfile changes don't understand some patterns, e.g. the pattern ?(abc|xyz) that would match 0 or more times 'abc' or 'xyz'
config.taskexplorer.excludeTask: Configure regex patterns for individual task namess that should be excluded from being displayed in the tasktree views
config.taskexplorer.globPatternsAnt: Configure additional glob patterns for locating Apache `Ant` files not named *b(B)uild.xml **Note:** the vsc filesystem watchers that process taskfile changes don't understand some patterns, e.g. the pattern ?(abc|xyz) that would match 0 or more times 'abc' or 'xyz'
config.taskexplorer.globPatternsBash: Configure additional glob patterns for locating `Bash` scripts without an *.sh* extension **Note:** the vsc filesystem watchers that process taskfile changes don't understand some patterns, e.g. the pattern ?(abc|xyz) that would match 0 or more times 'abc' or 'xyz'
config.taskexplorer.globPatternsNodejs: Configure additional glob patterns for locating `NodeJS` scripts **Note:** the vsc filesystem watchers that process taskfile changes don't understand some patterns, e.g. the pattern ?(abc|xyz) that would match 0 or more times 'abc' or 'xyz'
config.taskexplorer.groupWithSeparator: Group tasks and/or scripts into grouped tree nodes using the configured separator to obtain the grouping
config.taskexplorer.groupSeparator: The separator to use when grouping task and script names
config.taskexplorer.groupSeparatorEx: The extra character used for a set of grouped tasks to specify a variation of the same task, e.g. *build-all-prod, build-all-prod::verbose, build-all-prod::analyze*
config.taskexplorer.groupMaxLevel: Maximum grouping level (tree node depth) of grouped tasks
config.taskexplorer.groupScripts: Group script file types using the script file name (i.e. `bash, `python` `powershell`, etc)
config.taskexplorer.groupStripScriptLabe: Strip extracted grouping labels from the script name displayed in the tree (scripts types - i.e. `bash, `python` `powershell`, etc)
config.taskexplorer.groupStripTaskLabel: Strip extracted grouping labels from the task name displayed in the tree (task / non-script types - i.e. `npm, `gulp` `ant`, etc)
config.taskexplorer.includeAntDsc: Configure additional glob patterns for locating Apache Ant files not named b(B)uild.xml **Note:** the vsc filesystem watchers that process taskfile changes don't understand some patterns, e.g. the pattern ?(abc|xyz) that would match 0 or more times 'abc' or 'xyz'
config.taskexplorer.keepTermOnStop: Keep terminal open when stopping a task
config.taskexplorer.logging.level: Set log verbosity frm 1 to 5 where *1* is minimal and *5* is extra verbose (has no effect if `#logging.enable#` is *off*)
config.taskexplorer.logging.enableFile: Enable logging to file (has no effect if `#logging.enabled#` is *off*)
config.taskexplorer.logging.enableTags: Enable log entry tags to distinguish entries and allow easier tracing to where any issues are occurring, disabling tags reduces the underlying logger instance count from 10+ to just 1, consuming less system resources (has no effect if `#logging.enabled#` is *off*)
config.taskexplorer.logging.filterRegex: A regex pattern that can be used to filter all log writes for debugging purposes, discarding any entries that do not match, e.g '(?:npm|^ {3,}error\w+$|provideTasks|provider)
config.taskexplorer.pathToPrograms: Paths to bin / executable modules and programs, overrides the system **path** environment variable
config.taskexplorer.pathToAnsicon: Local path to the Ansicon executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToAnt: Local path to the Ant executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToApppublisher: Local path to the app-publisher executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToBash: Local path to the Bash / sh executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToBatchCmd: Local path to the Windows Cmd executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToComposer: Local path to the Composer executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToCurl: Local path to the Curl executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToEslint: Local path to the ESLint executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToGradle: Local path to the Gradle executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToGrunt: Local path to the Grunt executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToGulp: Local path to the Gulp executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToJenkins: Root URL of a Jenkins Server (no trailing slash), e.g. https://jenkins.mydomain.com
config.taskexplorer.pathToMake: Local path to the Make executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToMaven: Local path to the Maven executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToNodejs: Local path to the NodeJS executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToNpm: Local path to the Node Package Manager (i.e `npm`) executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToNsis: Local path to the Nullsoft Installer executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToPerl: Local path to the Perl executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToPipenv: Local path to the Pipenv executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToPowershell: Local path to the Powershell executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToPython: Local path to the Python executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToRuby: Local path to the Ruby executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToTsc: Local path to the Typescript executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToWebpackwrap: Local path to the webpack-wrap executable
config.taskexplorer.pathToWebpack: Local path to the webpack executable
config.taskexplorer.showHiddenWsTasks: Include VSCode tasks that have the `hide` property set when `#enableWorkspace#` tasks are enabled
config.taskexplorer.showRunningTask: Show the most recently started running task in the status bar
config.taskexplorer.sortProjectFoldersAl: Sort project folders alphabetically.  If not set, folders appear in the same order as the File Explorer View
config.taskexplorer.useAnt: Run the `ant` program itself to find it's tasks as opposed to the internal parser
config.taskexplorer.useGulp: Run the `gulp` program itself to find it's tasks as opposed to the internal parser.  Note this can be **extremely slow** as npx/gulp can take approximately up to 1.5s to parse **one** single file
config.taskexplorer.useGruntProvider: Use the internal `gradle` task provider when `#enableGrunt#` tasks are enabled.  For increased performance, disable the VSCode built-in grunt task provider (settings -> grunt -> auto detect) when using the internal provider
config.taskexplorer.useGradleProvider: Use the internal `gradle` task provider when `#enableGradle#` tasks are enabled.  For increased performance, disable any gradle task providers in VSCode (e.g. *Gradle for Java*) when using the internal provider
config.taskexplorer.useGulpProvider: Use the internal `gulp` task provider when `#enableGulp#` tasks are enabled.  For increased performance, disable the VSCode built-in gulp task provider (settings -> gulp -> auto detect) when using the internal provider
config.taskexplorer.useNpmProvider: Use the internal `npm` task provider  when `#enableNpm#` tasks are enabled.  For **significant** increased performance, disable the VSCode built-in npm task provider (settings -> npm -> auto detect) when using the internal provider
config.taskexplorer.useTscProvider: Use the internal `typescript` task provider  when `#enableTsc#` tasks are enabled.
config.taskexplorer.specialFolders.numLa: The number of tasks to store in the `Last Tasks` tree folder node
config.taskexplorer.specialFolders.showC: Show a `Commands` folder in the task tree to add custom cli commands in
config.taskexplorer.specialFolders.showF: Show a `Favorites` folder in the task tree to group selected 'favorite'  tasks in
Show a `Frequently Used Tasks` folder in the task tree to group the most frequently ran tasks in
config.taskexplorer.specialFolders.showL: Show `Last Tasks` as a folder in the task tree
config.taskexplorer.specialFolders.showU: Display user workspace tasks from data directory
config.taskexplorer.taskButtons.clickAct: Action to perform when clicking on the main body of a task tree entry
config.taskexplorer.taskButtons.controlC: The character to send to the terminal following the control character (i.e. *CTRL+C*) when `#keepTermOnStop#` is enabled.  In the U.S., this would be `Y`
config.taskexplorer.taskButtons.showExec: Show the `Execute with No Terminal` button inline with the Execute button
Show the `Execute with Arguments` button inline with the Execute button
config.taskexplorer.taskButtons.showFavo: Show the `Favorites` button inline with the Execute button. Has no effect if `#specialFolders.showFavorites#` is disabled
config.taskexplorer.usage.enabled: Track task statistics and application usage. **NOTE:** All data is stored locally only and does not participate in telemetry reporting unless `#usage.allowReporting#` is explicitly enabled
config.taskexplorer.usage.allowReporting: Allow task statistics and application usage tracking to participate in reported usage telemetry
config.taskexplorer.visual: Miscellaneous settings affecting visual appearance in some way
config.taskexplorer.visual.disableIconAn: Use static non-animated icons for running tasks as opposed to the spinning icons
config.taskexplorer.visual.enableAnsicon: Enable/use ansicon output colorization for ant tasks
config.taskexplorer.visual.taskPresentat: Behavior of terminal window when a task is started
config.taskexplorer.visual.taskTerminalS: Share terminal windows between tasks when ran, if disabled then each task will run in it's own separate terminal window
config.taskexplorer.visual.timerMode: Timer mode for running tasks, MM (2-digit minutes) + SS (2-digit seconds), and optional milliseconds MS1 | MS2 | MS3 where each denoted the precision of the decimal i.e. MS1 = 1-digit decimal (tenths of a second), MS2 = 2-digit precision (hundredths of a second, etc
config.taskexplorer.visual.treeNodeState: When a treenode is collapsed, also collapse any expanded child nodes (ignored if treenode state restoration is not enabled)
When a treenode is expanded or collapsed, synchronize state to the equivalent tasknode in all active tasktree views (ignored if treenode state restoration is not enabled)
taskdef.task.cmdLine: The command line used to execute the script in a shell
taskdef.task.fileName: The file that the target was found in
taskdef.task.fileUri: The uri object of file that the target was found in
taskdef.task.icon: The icon paths to use in the task tree.  Specify two properties on an object - light and dark
taskdef.task.isDefault: For Ant tasks, indicates the 'default' task
taskdef.task.name: The task name
taskdef.task.path: The relative path to the folder that contains the task file
taskdef.task.pathAbs: The absolute path to the folder that contains the task file
taskdef.task.project: The workspace project / folder name that the task belongs to
taskdef.task.scriptFile: Indicates that the task is a script-type task
taskdef.task.takesArgs: Indicates that the script accepts command line args
taskdef.task.taskFileId: The treefile id that the task is a child of
taskdef.task.taskItemId: The treeitem id that the task is associated with
taskdef.task.te: A flag indicating the task wis owned and provided by the TaskExplorer extension
command.addCommand: Add custom command to commands list
command.removeCommand: Remove custom command from commands list
command.addToExcludes: Add to taskfile search patterns exclusion list **Note:** the vsc filesystem watchers that process taskfile changes don't understand some patterns, e.g. the pattern ?(abc|xyz) that would match 0 or more times 'abc' or 'xyz'
command.clearCommands: Clear all custom commands from the `Commands` folder
command.clearFavorites: Clear all tasks from the `Favorites` folder
command.clearFrequentTasks: Clear all tasks from the `Frequently Used Tasks` folder
command.clearLastTasks: Clear all tasks from the `Last Tasks` folder
command.clearCache: Clear files cache and persisted task data
command.addToExcludesEx: Task Explorer: Add to taskfile search patterns exclusion list
command.backupClearDataStore: Task Explorer: Backup, clear, and reset datastore
command.clearDataStore: Task Explorer: Clear and reset datastore
command.clearUsage: Task Explorer: Clear and reset all usage data
command.disableTaskType: Task Explorer: Disable Tasks of this Type
command.enableTaskType: Task Explorer: Enable Tasks of this Type
command.openRepository: Task Explorer: GoTo Repository Home Page
command.removeFromExcludes: Task Explorer: Remove from taskfile search patterns exclusion list
command.setPinned: Task Explorer: Set task pinned state for current list
command.showOutput: Task Explorer: Show Log Output Window
command.view.welcome.show: Task Explorer: View Welcome / New Release Page
messages.noAssociatedTaskType: This file does not appear to be associated to any known task type
